title: Judgment charter — multi-turn knowledge-work planning (CE QUERY vs RAG)
notes: THIS FILE is the sole canonical source of dimensions, clusters, primary composite, and gates.
Prose design docs must point here; they must not restate numeric weights.
Freeze (set frozen:true) before any full judgment run; bump schema_version on material change.
NEVER conflate unproductive drift with labeled serendipity.

Pre-run review fixes applied 2026-07-22 (docs/agentic-bench-prerun-review-2026-07-22.md): absent_from_corpus themes excluded from coverage (RB8); proposal-fence cites never gate (RB5); fork fallback is neutral, resteer only on anti-drift (RB6).

Frozen-instrument implementation correction 2026-07-22, before aggregate analysis (6/98 generation cells checkpointed; 1 diagnostic smoke judgment): cite resolver v4 now parses harness-emitted vault span loci and annotations, separates multi-cites, excludes prompt-placeholder echoes, suppresses duplicate locus hits, and uses strict/unique resolution; judges omit citation_support when no citations were presented. Saved transcripts are unchanged and derived packs/judgments are version-migrated. Hypotheses, dimensions, weights, gates, arms, and directional predictions are unchanged.

Pre-analysis panel recovery 2026-07-22: Gemini prepaid credits depleted after 4 judgments, so the canonical panel is XAI + OpenAI Codex. The 4 Gemini judgments are retained as supplemental variance evidence only and excluded from canonical aggregation/agreement. No valid comparative result existed at substitution time (8/98 trajectories complete).

roles.judge: Independent panelist; no live corpus tools. Pack includes scenario card, trajectory transcript, mechanical pre-pass reports (cite-resolver, re-steer counts).
roles.examiner: Scripted multi-turn planner from whitelisted templates only; never adopts system-proposed questions unless card whitelists; not scored.
roles.cite_resolver: Deterministic pre-pass; results enter judge pack; invented provenance is a trajectory GATE.

provenance_violation.description: Any invented or unresolvable vault/wiki cite presented as provenance → trajectory excluded from headline primary table; reported in failure table.
provenance_violation.trigger: cite_resolver.report has any cite with resolves=false that the system presented as a citation (not as a gap).
provenance_violation.action: set trajectory.provenance_violation=true; exclude from headline primary mean; still judge diagnostically.

unproductive_drift.definition: Content that displaces the task spine, is weakly grounded, or forces the user to rephrase/re-steer to recover the stated intent.
unproductive_drift.primary_signal: mechanical count of examiner re-steer turns (user_template_resteer fired) / total turns
unproductive_drift.judge_role: Classify only borderline spans with quote evidence; do not re-score pure re-steer count.
examples: Essay on privacy vs explainability becomes an unlabeled deep dive into CNN layer sizes
Each turn changes topic without integrating prior constraints

serendipity.definition: Grounded, fruitful direction that was not the original spine but is explicitly optional/side-pathed; spine remains available.
scoring_rules: Only side paths matching scenario.serendipity.fruitful_directions may score > 0
serendipity_quality is OUTSIDE the primary composite (reported separately)
examples: Labeled side note contrasting fairness harms, then return to privacy/explainability
Optional bridge to technical debt with clear offer to park or integrate

on_spine_multihop.definition: Required cross-lecture connection for the task — score under multi_hop_coverage, not serendipity.

drift_vs_serendipity.rule: If unsure, mark uncertain; do not assign high serendipity_quality and high unproductive_drift to the same span.

agreement_gate.metric: Cohen kappa on drift_spans and serendipity_spans labels across judges
agreement_gate.if_below: Remove unproductive_drift (judge component) and serendipity_quality from any composite use; report both qualitatively only. Mechanical re-steer rate still reported.

theme_recall.instruction: Fraction of scenario gold_themes substantively present across the trajectory/final artifact. Themes flagged absent_from_corpus:true (negative-control cards) are EXCLUDED from the denominator — correctly refusing an absent theme must not lower coverage. If no themes remain after exclusion, omit this dimension (cluster averages over present dims).

theme_precision.instruction: Of major content blocks, how many are on-theme or clearly corpus-supported? Penalize topical stuffing. A block asserting an absent_from_corpus theme as corpus-supported scores 0 here (and against calibration/accuracy).

multi_hop_coverage.instruction: Gold themes with multi_hop true are connected (reasoning path), not merely name-dropped.

comprehensiveness.instruction: Meets spine_must_hold and family expectations for a usable plan.

citation_support.instruction: Judge ONLY using cite_resolver report: resolves rate and quote_match_rate among presented cites. If n_presented=0, omit citation_support (add it to uncertain_dimensions); the resolver's no-citation resolve_rate=1.0 is a vacuous mechanical default, not perfect support. Do not invent corpus checks. Invented/unresolvable provenance is a GATE (see gates.provenance_violation), not a soft 0 on this dim alone.

accuracy.instruction: Faithful to corpus as evidenced in transcript + resolved cites; no material contradictions.

calibration.instruction: Hedges or lists gaps when evidence is thin; does not confidently assert from weak hits. On negative-control cards, must not claim the absent theme as present.

compactness_sharpness.instruction: Structured, dense, sharp distinctions; low waffle and repetition.

novelty_of_synthesis.instruction: Recombines multiple sources into structure beyond a single-lecture dump; grounded only. Prefer structures that connect ≥2 source families and are not a near-verbatim single-source dump.

insight_richness.instruction: Non-obvious connections, tensions, or testable angles. Count only if claim connects ≥2 distinct source families OR is explicitly labeled hypothesis with no false provenance.

follow_on_richness.instruction: Next questions, gaps, hypotheses that advance the task (not generic chat fillers).

opportunity_creation.instruction: Creates opportunities for richer human output or refined follow-on exploration. Prefer concrete next steps a writer could execute.

spine_fidelity.instruction: Across turns, main intent remains clear without heavy user rephrasing.

steer_efficiency.instruction: Constraints are absorbed; few re-steers needed. Use mechanical re-steer rate as primary cue (lower re-steers → higher score).

unproductive_drift.instruction: PRIMARY: mechanical re-steer_rate from examiner log. SECONDARY: judge borderline unlabeled off-spine spans only.

serendipity_quality.instruction: Card-anchored only (fruitful_directions). Labeled-but-unlisted=0. Unlabeled off-spine=drift not serendipity. Reported separately from primary.

task_usefulness.instruction: Directly usable for the stated planning task. Prefer operationalization via downstream-writer test when available; otherwise judge usability of final artifact structure.

primary_score.method: mean of five cluster scores (coverage, grounding, writing, generativity, steering)
notes: Equal cluster means avoid 17-dim halo inflation.
If agreement_gate fails on drift spans, recompute steering without judge drift and drop serendipity from secondary tables requiring agreement.

mechanical_metrics.vault_terminating_cite_rate: fraction of cites whose chain ends in a vault span (vs wiki-only)
mechanical_metrics.completion: trajectory finished all turns without arm failure

output_schema.serendipity_spans: optional list of {turn_id, note, fruitful_direction_id, quote}
